summary: Hollis County is taking sealed bids to replace one 200-ton air-cooled chiller on the roof of the Hollis County Justice Center in Hollis, Utah, a building that includes the county jail and stays in operation at all times. The engineer's estimate is $620,000 to $700,000. Bids are due Thursday, March 25, 2027, but the text gives two different times: 3:00 p.m. in the Notice and 2:00 p.m. in Section 4.

notes.text: The text gives two different times for bids on Thursday, March 25, 2027. The Notice says bids are due at 3:00 p.m. Section 4 says they must be delivered no later than 2:00 p.m. The text does not say which one is right. This reading uses 2:00 p.m., the earlier time, taken from the section on submitting bids. Confirm the time with the County.
The bid must show at least two chiller replacements of 150 tons or larger completed in the last five years. This sits inside the list of things to include and is easy to miss.

The building includes the county jail and courtrooms and stays in operation at all times. Cooling may be interrupted for no more than 48 hours in total, and the new chiller must be operating by May 28, 2027, about nine weeks after bids are due. The text does not say when the award will be made.
The bid must include a signed acknowledgment of the Jail Security Rules in Appendix C. Appendix C was not part of the text that was read, so what those rules require is not known.

The pre-bid conference and roof visit is not required; the text says bidders are encouraged to attend. Anyone who does attend must bring government-issued photo identification. Questions must be in writing by March 12, 2027, but the text gives no time of day and does not say who to send them to.
